results.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
results.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

results.title: THE CURE
results.overview: Years after leaving her family and hometown behind to build a life of her own, Nisa returns to her aunt Zehra’s home for her uncle’s funeral. Having come from the same past but drifted into different lives, the two women recognize familiar traces of themselves in one another, as well as the possibilities of lives that might have been. Their encounter leads Nisa to reconsider her own past and future.

results.title: ENDGAME: Trump’s Midterns
results.overview: Trump's midterms: Democracy under threat in America. From Washington DC to Mississippi, South Carolina, New York, Tennessee and Colorado, Four Corners reporter Mark Willacy investigates whether the greatest threat to the elections comes from within the Trump administration itself. Donald Trump may not be on the ballot, but the election is a referendum on his presidency. With his approval rating at a record low, Trump is rallying his MAGA base, warning of electoral fraud and impeachment if the Democrats take control of Congress. Former Trump insiders are sounding the alarm over efforts to undermine confidence in the vote, including the prospect of ICE agents being deployed at polling places. Their warning: a desperate president could go to extraordinary lengths to cling to power.
